article: Launch Hidemaru Editor with the hide command
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; compared every instruction and translation, checked App Paths hive and value semantics, .reg syntax and escaping, command invocation, localized descriptions, dates, internal links, references, and image.
findings: Removed a duplicate future publication date in all editions and preserved the original date (2024-03-29); set lastmod to 2026-11-25.
Changed the registry example to the current-user App Paths key. Microsoft recommends per-user registration for per-user apps; HKLM is for all users.
Clarified that Path is optional and prepends directories to the launched process PATH; removed it from the sample because it is not needed for this launcher.
Clarified that Run accepts hide while Command Prompt uses start hide; direct hide is not the method described. Corrected all translated descriptions accordingly.
Added localized warning to replace the sample executable path, documented the elevated HKLM alternative, and linked current Microsoft documentation.
